name: mirage
text: No, don't delete everything. Old keys sitting in your Novig account are harmless; each device and the engine uses only its own key, and deleting one that is in use is what breaks things. The only ones that matter: (1) the engine's read-only key, named 'Vigilant cloud engine' (newest one is the good one); (2) the trading key on GitHub for the engine's orders; (3) your phone's and tablet's own keys. Step by step: 1) Leave every key in place. 2) Wait for my next message: I'm checking the engine now uses the newest 'Vigilant cloud engine' key. 3) If it works, I'll tell you which older 'Vigilant cloud engine' keys are safe to revoke (only those; never the trading or phone/tablet keys). 4) Phone and tablet hand bets and bids share the same subaccount trading key you chose earlier, so they don't interfere with each other or the engine's orders (the engine's bids carry their own order IDs, and the repeat-guard counts everyone's bets together). Nothing else needs doing right now.
